post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As the assassin, I successfully completed two missions (1 and 2), showing adaptability and strategic decision-making in those moments. However, I failed to eliminate the Merlin (Eve) and did not prevent the Good team from achieving their goal, indicating room for improvement in my ability to manipulate game conditions to my advantage. With a stronger understanding of team dynamics and risk tolerance, I could have made more effective decisions.

player_observations.Bob: Bob consistently revealed his loyalty as a Good player, demonstrating a lack of adaptability to counter-espionage strategies, which made it easier for me to identify and target him. He seemed to rely heavily on his teammates and underutilized the resources and information available to him.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie demonstrated strong leadership throughout the game, showcasing effective communication and strategic planning that allowed the team to achieve their goals. His ability to work well with others and make informed decisions when I was a part of his team was particularly notable.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's loyalty as a Good player seemed to be her strong suit, but she struggled to provide effective support and cover for her teammates. Her tendency to play it safe and follow established plans made her predictable and vulnerable to my assassin moves, which made it easier to target her.
player_observations.Eve: Although I never directly interacted with Eve as the Assassin, observing her as the Merlin revealed a masterful ability to manipulate events and guide the Good team towards their objectives while preventing our team's success. Her influence often proved decisive in determining the outcome of the game.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was overconfident in the missions I led and underestimated the abilities of the opposing team. I couldn't effectively read the intentions of Alice during the last two missions, which led to our failures. With more caution and communication with Diana, we might have been more successful.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was highly unpredictable and managed to bluff her way through multiple missions without raising any suspicion, but ultimately revealed her true intentions as the assassin. Her ability to remain calm and composed under pressure was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie performed exceptionally well as a Minion, completing his objectives seamlessly without attracting much attention to himself. He was effective in manipulating the game's outcome.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was a strong team player and made effective decisions during her leadership, which contributed to the success of her missions.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played the role of Merlin expertly, providing crucial information and guidance to ensure the completion of the missions. Her insight and leadership were invaluable to the opposing team.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed well in this game, successfully leading my team to victory in three out of the five missions. I was able to effectively utilize my evil abilities to hinder the good players' progress and ultimately led them to multiple failures. My only room for improvement would be in my ability to consistently identify the Merlin's actions, which could have allowed me to make more strategic decisions.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played tightly as an assassin, often going unnoticed and striking strategically, but sometimes overplayed her role, giving away her position.
player_observations.Bob: Bob consistently played as a classic good guy, providing support but rarely taking risks or making bold moves that would have impacted the game.
player_observations.Charlie: That's me, haha! I guess I played myself pretty well.
player_observations.Diana: Diana made some interesting decisions as a good player, sometimes choosing to play it safe, while other times taking calculated risks, but she often fell short of turning the tide in favor of the good team.
player_observations.Eve: Eve proved to be an effective Merlin, using her abilities wisely to guide her teammates and make crucial decisions that greatly impacted the outcome of the game. She was nearly perfect in her role.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did a good job in supporting the team as a leader in mission 2 and also contributing to mission 5's goal. However, I couldn't prevent the final mission from failing due to insufficient intelligence and failed coordination with the team on enemy role detection.

player_observations.Alice: As the assassin, Alice played stealthily and effectively used her abilities to contribute to the team's success in mission 1, though she struggled in later missions. She failed to disguise her role well, resulting in her early reveal.
player_observations.Bob: Being a good player, Bob seemed like he relied heavily on other players to provide information, and his participation was minimal. He had little to no impact on the final outcome.
player_observations.Charlie: As an effective evil player, Charlie demonstrated great leadership skills, carefully choosing his moments to act and manipulating information to his advantage. His presence was a significant factor in the game's outcome.
player_observations.Eve: Merlin, Eve, played cleverly, providing crucial information to support the mission goals. She effectively used her knowledge of the player roles to guide the team, especially when she had to work with me in mission 2.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I feel I was unable to effectively utilize my knowledge and information to guide the team to victory. Although I successfully identified potential traitors, I was unable to prevent their actions or make informed decisions in critical missions. In hindsight, I should have been more proactive in my deception-detection and team management.

player_observations.Alice: I was surprised by Alice's consistent behavior as an assassin, making it difficult for me to detect her true role, and her willingness to sacrifice individual missions for a larger evil goal.
player_observations.Bob: Despite playing the role of a good player, Bob's decisions often seemed predictable and naive, allowing Charlie to outmaneuver him.
player_observations.Charlie: As the leader of the evil team, Charlie demonstrated exceptional strategic thinking, using his knowledge of the players' roles to manipulate the game board and steer the game to the evil's advantage.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played a solid role as a loyal good player, working effectively within her role and making key contributions to the team's success during the early missions, though she struggled to make a significant impact in the final missions.
